description: A depth stage keeps a value and the facts it reads directly, in the order why lists them
code:
price = 10
qty = 3
shipping = 5
subtotal = price * qty
total = subtotal + shipping
(total |> why |> depth(1)).map(step -> step.node)

description: Depth counts the shortest path, so a fact read two steps away stays within depth 2 although the walk reaches it through a longer path
code:
base = 1
u = base + 1
s = u + 1
q = s * 2
p = u * 3
t = p + q
[(why t).map(step -> step.node), (t |> why |> depth(2)).map(step -> step.node)]

description: Depth 1 after affects selects the direct dependents of a value and depth 0 selects nothing
code:
price = 10
tax = price * 2
total = price + tax
label = total * 3
[(affects price).map(step -> step.node), (price |> affects |> depth(1)).map(step -> step.node), price |> affects |> depth(0)]

description: A depth limit read from a variable keeps the selection live as the limit changes
code:
a = 1
b = a + 1
c = b * 2
limit = 1
near = c |> why |> depth(limit)
limit = 2
near.map(step -> step.node)

description: A limit that is not known yet leaves the selection null until it is set
code:
a = 1
c = a + 1
class Plan
plan = Plan()
near = c |> why |> depth(plan.depth)
waiting := near
plan.depth = 0
[waiting, near.map(step -> step.node)]

description: A depth limit that is not a non-negative integer raises a TypeError naming the limit
code:
a = 1
c = a + 1
n = 1.5
try:
    c |> why |> depth(n)
catch error:
    out = error
out
return: "TypeError: n is not a non-negative integer"

description: A binding named depth shadows the stage, as bindings shadow the stated and derived filters
code:
a = 1
c = a + 1
depth = 2
try:
    c |> why |> depth(1)
catch error:
    out = error
out

description: A class-level rule gives every instance the direct causes of its own total
code:
class Order(qty, price):
    this.qty = qty
    this.price = price
$Order.units = $Order.qty * 10
$Order.total = $Order.units * $Order.price
$Order.causes = $Order.total |> why |> depth(1)
pen = Order(2, 3)
cup = Order(1, 9)
[pen.causes.map(step -> step.node), cup.causes.map(step -> step.holds)]
